places.name: Congee Village

places.avoid: Skip the fried crullers, anything deep-fried and the bamboo rice; no chili oil, go easy on white pepper.
places.notes: Sources disagree on hours (some say 10:30–02:00). Call (212) 941-1818 before going.

places.name: Great N.Y. Noodletown

places.avoid: Skip fatty roast meats and salt-and-pepper fried dishes; little ginger-scallion sauce, no chili oil.
places.notes: Mostly cash. Open until 4 am (Michelin / Time Out): a top late-night option when your stomach is off.

places.name: Big Wong
places.avoid: No fried cruller on the side, skip the fatty roast pork, no chili oil.
places.notes: Cash only.

places.name: Kong Sihk Tong

Congee if on the day's menu (生滚粥 / 白粥)
places.avoid: No HK milk tea, yuenyeung or iced lemon tea; skip French toast and fried items.
places.notes: Sunday hours unconfirmed. Cash or Venmo.

places.name: Nom Wah Tea Parlor

Steamed chicken or BBQ pork buns (蒸包)

places.name: Golden Steamer

places.notes: Takeout only; often sold out by 3 pm. Cash or Venmo. No reliable source for hours.

places.name: Mei Lai Wah

places.avoid: Skip the pineapple bun (lots of butter), egg tarts, coffee and milk tea.

Pandan sponge cake (斑兰海绵蛋糕)

places.name: Fong On

places.name: Kossar's Bagels & Bialys

places.name: Remedy Diner

buy: Chicken noodle or chicken rice soup
places.avoid: No fries, bacon or coffee; skip the orange juice.

places.name: Tsurutontan (Midtown)

places.notes: Hours from the official site; older sources claiming 24h are outdated.

places.name: 2nd Ave Deli (Murray Hill)

places.name: Tick Tock Diner
buy: Chicken noodle or chicken rice soup
places.avoid: No coffee, orange juice, fries or bacon.

Plain toast or English muffin, no butter

places.name: Zabar's

places.name: Lexington Candy Shop

places.name: Leo's Bagels
